description: This file contains unit tests for DynamoDB storage operations, including CRUD, conditional updates, and concurrency control, using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: DynamoDBStorageTests
classes.description: Unit test class for DynamoDB storage operations, testing create, read, update, delete, and query functionalities.

methods.name: DynamoDBStorageTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test class, setting up the data manager and partition key.

methods.name: GenerateNewData
methods.description: Generates a new test data item with unique partition and row keys.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_CreateItemAsync
methods.description: Tests creating a new item with conditional check to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_UpsertItemAsync
methods.description: Tests upserting (insert or update) an item, including concurrency control with ETag.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_DeleteItemAsync
methods.description: Tests deleting an item from DynamoDB.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_ReadSingleTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Tests reading a single table entry by key.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_ReadAllTableEntryByPartitionAsync
methods.description: Tests querying all entries by partition key.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of key attributes for a data item.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of attribute values for a data item, optionally including key attributes.
